raw_findings.body: The rendered PR comment body contains an extra blank line between every issue entry instead of a single line break, degrading comment readability.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Visible formatting defect in generated PR comments (double blank lines) that is easy to miss without rendering the actual output.
raw_findings.impact: The rendered PR comment body contains an extra blank line between every issue entry instead of a single line break, degrading comment readability.
raw_findings.root_cause: New template string bakes in its own newline terminator while callers still join entries with an additional newline separator.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Remove the trailing `\n` from MERGED_PR_SINGLE_ISSUE_TEMPLATE (let the callers' `"\n".join` supply the separator) or change callers to `"".join(...)`.
raw_findings.title: Merged PR issue template embeds trailing newline causing double line breaks

raw_findings.suggested_fix: Log `str(e)` (or use `logger.exception`) instead of passing the raw exception object in `extra`.
